detailed_descriptions.en: Bonehold is a 3D roguelike dungeon crawler with ARPG and hack-and-slash elements, blending fast-paced combat with strategic exploration. Choose from 7 unique character classes , including the Knight , Barbarian , Scorcher , Spellblade, and more, each offering distinct playstyles and abilities. Venture into Bonehold’s ancient fortress, battling hordes of skeletons, ghosts, and magical abominations. Discover procedurally generated treasure s like weapons, spells, and armor, allowing endless possibilities for custom builds. The game’s striking art style combines hand-painted textures with pixel art , creating a visually stunning and immersive world. Only the brave and skilled will conquer Bonehold’s depths, are you ready?

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Bonehold is a 3D roguelike dungeon crawler with ARPG and hack-and-slash elements, blending fast-paced combat with strategic exploration.

Choose from 7 unique character classes, including the Knight, Barbarian, Scorcher, Spellblade, and more, each offering distinct playstyles and abilities.

Venture into Bonehold’s ancient fortress, battling hordes of skeletons, ghosts, and magical abominations.

Discover procedurally generated treasures like weapons, spells, and armor, allowing endless possibilities for custom builds.

The game’s striking art style combines hand-painted textures with pixel art, creating a visually stunning and immersive world.

Only the brave and skilled will conquer Bonehold’s depths, are you ready?
